payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Astrid, Gillian, Harry, Mi, Reanna, Stefania

payload.content: Planning: Gillian considering tasks. With skills ui-ux-design (0.87) + security (0.71), I can cover ISSUE-0002 security work cheaply. ISSUE-0001 tasks have very high cost for me (24-60). I will likely pick at most one of ISSUE-0002 {implement/review/test}; please avoid others duplicating if possible.
Request: if others cover ISSUE-0001 critical, I’ll take one ISSUE-0002 item (probably review or test). Let me know which you plan to take so we don’t duplicate.

Stefania (security heavy, 8h). ISSUE-0001 tasks are very high cost for me (24-60); I plan to avoid them. I can cheaply take ISSUE-0002::review or test, or implement if needed. Gillian said they'd take one ISSUE-0002 item—please confirm your chosen item so we avoid duplicates.
From Stefania side: I likely will pick ISSUE-0002::review (effort 1.0, cost 1.75) if Gillian takes test or implement; otherwise I can switch to test (cost 2.45) but prefer review to minimize cost.

Planning (Mi): With high security skill and low costs only for ISSUE-0002, I will claim ISSUE-0002::review (effort 1.0, medium, cost 1.81). I will avoid ISSUE-0001 critical tasks due to very high cost. Please assign remaining ISSUE-0002 items to other agents or let them skip to avoid duplicates; I will not take implement/test.

Reanna planning update: I’m available 6h with best skills api-development (0.98). I can take an ISSUE-0001 critical api-development subtask (triage/review/docs) or skip if others cover. To avoid duplicates with others, I will pick ISSUE-0001::triage unless someone confirms they will take it; please let me know your intended choices.

Harry planning: I have 5h, best fit is ISSUE-0002 security (ui-ux-design+security). ISSUE-0001 critical api-development tasks are extremely high cost for me (triage 24, review 30, docs 30, test 42, implement 61). I will take ISSUE-0002::implement (effort 2.0, prio medium) if unclaimed; otherwise can take ISSUE-0002::test or ::review as backup. Please confirm to avoid duplicates.

Astrid planning: my top skill is ui-ux-design (0.72). I’m considering taking an ISSUE-0002 security micro-task since ISSUE-0001 api-development has very high cost for me (24-60). Mi indicated they will take ISSUE-0002::review; Harry said they may take ISSUE-0002::implement; Gillian unsure. I will avoid duplicates—please confirm whether ISSUE-0002::implement or ::test are still unclaimed.

Astrid offer: if unclaimed, I can take ISSUE-0002::test (effort 1.4) or ISSUE-0002::implement (effort 2.0), but prefer test for availability/cost vs implement. Please reply with claimed item to prevent duplicate assignments.

Gillian (planning): I will take ISSUE-0002::test (effort 1.4, medium) unless someone confirms they already plan to take it. My costs for ISSUE-0002 are lowest for review but I’ll cover test to avoid overlap with Mi (review) / Harry (maybe implement).

Stefania planning confirmation: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review if unclaimed; given Mi intends ISSUE-0002::review, I’m ready to switch to ISSUE-0002::test (cost 2.45) to avoid duplicate. Please confirm what you’re taking.
Stefania note: I am avoiding all ISSUE-0001 critical api-development tasks due to very high costs. Prefer covering remaining ISSUE-0002 security subtasks to maximize tasks_done without duplicates.

Mi planning confirmation: I will take ISSUE-0002::review (Improve security [review]) to avoid duplicates on ISSUE-0001 due to high cost. Others please coordinate remaining ISSUE-0002 items (implement/test) accordingly; I will not take implement/test.
Reanna planning: I will choose ISSUE-0001::triage (critical, effort 2.4, cost 2.22) unless someone else confirms they already plan to take it. I am not taking any ISSUE-0002 security subtasks.

Harry planning confirm: I intend to take ISSUE-0002::implement (Improve security [implement], effort 2.0) to match my ui-ux+security skills. I will avoid ISSUE-0001 (critical api-development) due to very high costs. Please do not also claim ISSUE-0002::implement.

Astrid update: From my side I can take ISSUE-0002::test (effort 1.4) or ISSUE-0002::implement (2.0). I see Gillian intends ISSUE-0002::test and Harry intends ISSUE-0002::implement, while Mi intends ISSUE-0002::review. To avoid duplicates I will likely skip unless someone drops their claim.
[Gillian] Planning confirmation: I will claim ISSUE-0002::test (medium) to avoid duplicates with Mi (review) and Harry (implement). I will not touch ISSUE-0001 due to prohibitive costs.

Stefania planning: after seeing Mi intends ISSUE-0002::review and Gillian/others cover test+implement, I will skip ISSUE-0002 to avoid duplicates (and I can’t do ISSUE-0001 feasibly). Confirming I will choose 'skip' in execution unless a slot opens up.
Mi planning: confirming I will take ISSUE-0002::review (Improve security [review]) in execution; I will not take implement/test. Please ensure others avoid duplicates for ISSUE-0002::review.

Reanna (planning): I confirm I will take ISSUE-0001::triage (critical api-development) in execution, and I will not take any ISSUE-0002 security tasks. Please do not claim ISSUE-0001::triage to avoid duplicates; others can cover remaining ISSUE-0002 subtasks as planned.

Harry (planning): I’m confirmed to claim ISSUE-0002::implement in execution (effort 2.0, medium). I will avoid ISSUE-0001 entirely due to high costs. Please ensure no one else takes ISSUE-0002::implement; others can cover ISSUE-0002::test (Gillian) and ISSUE-0002::review (Mi).

Astrid planning: I will skip ISSUE-0002 to avoid duplicates since Mi already takes review, Gillian takes test, and Harry takes implement. I will avoid ISSUE-0001 due to very high costs (24-60). Confirming skip in execution.

Gillian planning update (Phase=planning): I intend to take ISSUE-0002::test (Improve security [test], effort 1.4, medium). I will not take ISSUE-0001 critical tasks. Confirming coordination: Mi=review, Harry=implement, others skip.

Stefania (planning, iter1): based on earlier coordination, ISSUE-0002::review is already claimed by Mi; ISSUE-0002::test by Gillian; ISSUE-0002::implement by Harry. Since ISSUE-0001 critical tasks are too costly for me, I will take 'skip' in execution.

[Mi planning] Confirming execution intent: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review (Improve security [review]). I will not take any ISSUE-0001 critical api-development tasks. Please avoid duplicates on ISSUE-0002::review.

Reanna planning broadcast: I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage (critical, api-development) in execution; I will not claim any ISSUE-0002 items. Please ensure no one else takes ISSUE-0001::triage to avoid duplicates.

[Harry planning] Confirming in execution I will claim ISSUE-0002::implement (Improve security [implement]) only. I will NOT take any other tasks. Coordinate: Mi=ISSUE-0002::review, Gillian=ISSUE-0002::test, Reanna=ISSUE-0001::triage, others skip.

Astrid on planning: already coordinated that ISSUE-0002::review=test=implement are taken by Mi/Gillian/Harry respectively; ISSUE-0001 tasks too costly for me. I will choose 'skip' in execution to avoid duplicates/infeasible claims.
